status_note: EXT2025 extension of the accepted ARMS01 WTA comparison to {{out:cohort/years|first|d}}-{{out:cohort/years|last|d}} (design amendments A1 and A3), scored once with the accepted ARMS01 scorer. 2025 was inspected before the model freeze (D134) and scored by REFIT2025 (D137 ATP, D138 WTA): it is exposed retrospective data, not a holdout. registration.amendments: A1 (BuildOak 2025 fits; accepted 2024 reproductions byte-identical before the 2025 output is used), A3 (scoring: accepted ARMS01 scorer, frozen model as the only Alcaraz arm, blend years extended by 2025, no power restatement)
registration.readings: EXT2025 fixes readings, not gates: every extended number is reported whatever it shows; the scorer's verdict strings are kept under scorer_verdicts and read descriptively (A3)

endpoint.estimand: match-weighted paired log-loss difference, left minus right, on identical matches; negative favours the left
endpoint.note: Brier and winner accuracy are descriptive companions; log loss is the sole gated endpoint.

cohort.definition: all WTA primary targets 2019-2025: the accepted 2019-2024 ARMS01 membership in its order, then the 2025 REFIT2025 primary targets with a frozen-model forecast; neutral orientation; retirements retained
cohort.priced_subset: none; the WTA secondary registered no market reference line

arm1.label: full_entry
arm1.role: the frozen model (D134): ARMS01 WTA attempt 002 forecasts for 2019-2024, REFIT2025 WTA attempt 001 for 2025; the only Alcaraz arm scored (A3)

arm0.label: full
arm0.role: the previous version; its forecast files are bound for the record and it is not scored in EXT2025 (A3)

buildoak.label: BuildOak XGBoost WTA adaptation
buildoak.adaptation: the accepted ARMS01 walk-forward replay for 2019-2024 plus one fit at the 2024-12-30 boundary for 2025 with the frozen adaptation, in the same Colima adapter; the 2025 output is used only because the accepted 2024 run reproduced byte for byte in that environment (A1)
buildoak.structural_break: the recent-era blend is inactive in 2019-2023 and active in 2024 (accepted WTA record) and in 2025: {{fit_2025:recent_blend/recent_rows|int}} recent rows (from {{fit_2025:recent_blend/recent_start|raw}}) against the frozen threshold of {{fit_2025:recent_blend/min_recent_rows|int}}, weight {{fit_2025:recent_blend/recent_weight|f2}} on the recent model for all {{fit_2025:target_rows|int}} 2025 targets; the pooled contrasts mix both regimes

reproduction_2024.rule: the 2025 output is used only if the accepted 2024 run reproduces byte for byte in the same environment (A1)

contrast3_blend.form: blend logit = (1 - w) * logit(Alcaraz) + w * logit(BuildOak)

readings.gates: none: EXT2025 fixes readings, not gates (A3); the scorer's verdict strings stay in the archive result file and are not a pass or a release
readings.blend: descriptive: the registered WTA blend release (D133) rests on the accepted 2022-2024 result, not on this extension

uncertainty_method.week_label: ISO week of the panel's tourney_anchor_date (calendar Monday)
uncertainty_method.conditioning: intervals condition on the saved forecasts and omit refit, selection and source-choice uncertainty

accepted_result.note: the registered result, unchanged (buildoak_wta_2019_2024.json); shown beside the extension

limitations: exposed retrospective comparison of complete systems with different legitimate histories; not an untouched test, prospective evidence or a market claim

2025 was inspected before the model freeze (D134) and scored by REFIT2025 (D137 ATP, D138 WTA): it is exposed retrospective data, not a holdout. The extended interval shares its first seasons with the registered one and is not an independent confirmation.

the recent-era blend is inactive in 2019-2023 and active in 2024 (accepted WTA record) and in 2025: {{fit_2025:recent_blend/recent_rows|int}} recent rows (from {{fit_2025:recent_blend/recent_start|raw}}) against the frozen threshold of {{fit_2025:recent_blend/min_recent_rows|int}}, weight {{fit_2025:recent_blend/recent_weight|f2}} on the recent model for all {{fit_2025:target_rows|int}} 2025 targets; the pooled contrasts mix both regimes
the BuildOak recipe was selected by its author on ROC AUC with sight of 2026 data
intervals condition on saved forecasts; no family-wise adjustment
no claim beyond the named systems, this cohort and paired log loss
